mutants.name: ntt-wrong-zeta
mutants.description: One zeta in the generated table is wrong (entry for i=77 replaced by zeta[76]).
mutants.expect: mlkem_poly_ntt whole-transform on random/all q-1 (only pairs under zeta 77 differ); per-layer trace names L=6 for NTT and L=0 for INTT.

mutants.name: reduce-bound-off-by-one
mutants.description: Reduction compares against q+1 (or the Barrett quotient is biased by one) so an input of exactly q, or exactly k*q, is left unreduced.
mutants.expect: mlkem_poly_reduce[k*q boundaries + extremes] and [all q] report a NON-CANONICAL coefficient (S1).

mutants.name: ntt-missing-final-reduce
mutants.description: The final canonicalising pass at the end of mlkem_poly_ntt (or its last layer) is removed, so a coefficient in [q, 2q) is returned.
mutants.expect: mlkem_poly_ntt[all q-1] / random: first diff flagged NON-CANONICAL; intt(ntt(f)) may still pass, which is precisely why S1 compares canonical values.

mutants.name: butterfly-swapped-operand
mutants.description: In the CT butterfly, f[j] and f[j+len] are exchanged on the subtract side (f[j+len] = t - f[j] instead of f[j] - t).
mutants.expect: mlkem_ntt_layer L=0 on impulse[255]=q-1 and all q-1; whole NTT on every non-zero case.

mutants.name: loop-bpl-256
mutants.description: A 256-iteration coefficient loop (reduce, add or sub) counts down with bpl instead of bne/beq+jmp, so it exits after iteration 128 (or after one iteration when starting from 255) — P1's keccak_clear bug shape.
mutants.expect: mlkem_poly_reduce[all 0xFFFF] / mlkem_poly_add[all q-1, all q-1]: first diff at coeff 128 (or 0..254).

mutants.name: basemul-accumulator-24bit
mutants.description: basemul accumulates a0*b0 + zeta*(a1*b1) without reducing a1*b1 first, in a 24-bit accumulator (carry into byte 3 dropped).
mutants.expect: mlkem_poly_basemul[all q-1 x all q-1 (S4 accumulator width)].

mutants.name: basemul-zeta-sign
mutants.description: The sign alternation of gamma between the two halves of each pair (zeta^{2*BitRev7(i)+1} vs its negative) is dropped.
mutants.expect: mlkem_poly_basemul[impulse[3]=q-1 x impulse[3]=q-1] and [impulse[255] x impulse[255]] (odd pairs), whole random cases.

mutants.name: sub-no-wrap
mutants.description: mlkem_poly_sub omits the +q correction when the difference is negative.
mutants.expect: mlkem_poly_sub[zero, all q-1 (S3 wrap)]: NON-CANONICAL 0xF2FF-style result.

mutants.name: intt-scale-wrong
mutants.description: The final 128^-1 = 3303 multiply uses 3302 (or is skipped).
mutants.expect: mlkem_poly_intt whole transform and intt(ntt(f)) == f; per-layer trace passes through L=5 and names L=6 or the full function.

mutants.name: ntt-data-dependent-branch
mutants.description: A conditional early-out on a zero coefficient (skip the multiply when f[j+len] == 0) — functionally correct, timing leaks.
mutants.expect: timing section: mlkem_poly_ntt constant-time check (S5) — all-zero measures fewer cycles than random.

mutants.name: wp2-cbd-short
mutants.description: mlkem_sample_cbd2: loop consumes 127 of the 128 PRF bytes (last two coefficients never written)
mutants.expect: mlkem_sample_cbd2 [all-0xFF]: index 254

mutants.name: wp2-compress-floor
mutants.description: mlkem_compress_10: drop the +q/2 (round-half-up) term so compress computes floor(2^d*x/q)
mutants.expect: mlkem_compress_10 [boundaries 0..]

mutants.name: wp2-compress-floor-4
mutants.description: mlkem_compress_4: same as wp2-compress-floor for d=4 (a separate routine or table row)
mutants.expect: mlkem_compress_4 [boundaries 0..]

mutants.name: wp2-decompress-shift
mutants.description: mlkem_decompress_10: rounding constant one bit short: add 2^(d-2) instead of 2^(d-1) before the >> d
mutants.expect: mlkem_decompress_10 [exhaustive

mutants.name: wp2-decompress-shift-1
mutants.description: mlkem_decompress_1: decompress_1 returns floor(q/2)=1664 for y=1 instead of round(q/2)=1665
mutants.expect: mlkem_decompress_1 [exhaustive 0..]: index 1: got 1664 want 1665

mutants.name: wp2-sample-ntt-accept-q
mutants.description: mlkem_sample_ntt: rejection test uses d <= q instead of d < q (a candidate equal to 3329 is accepted)
mutants.expect: stream carries a d == q

mutants.name: wp2-sample-ntt-d2-after-full
mutants.description: mlkem_sample_ntt: drop the j < 256 guard on d2 so a valid d2 is stored after the 256th coefficient
mutants.expect: wrote past the 512-byte output buffer

mutants.name: wp2-encode-nibble-swap
mutants.description: mlkem_byte_encode_12: middle byte packed as (a1 & 0xF) | (a0 >> 8) << 4 instead of (a0 >> 8) | (a1 & 0xF) << 4
mutants.expect: mlkem_byte_encode_12 [nibble-asymmetric 0x0A5 / 0x5A0]: byte index 1

mutants.name: wp3-skip-rejection-compare
mutants.description: mlkem_decaps: the c == c' compare result is ignored and K' is always returned (implicit rejection never taken)
mutants.expect: mlkem_decaps [decapsulation tcId 88 modified ciphertext]: K (implicit rejection J(z||c)) differs at byte 0

mutants.name: wp3-early-exit-compare
mutants.description: mlkem_decaps: the 1,088-byte c == c' compare returns on the FIRST mismatching byte instead of OR-accumulating over the full length (functionally correct; timing leaks where the ciphertext was tampered)
mutants.expect: mlkem_decaps: constant-time in c (T1)

mutants.name: wp3-swap-du-dv
mutants.description: K-PKE.Encrypt: u compressed with d_v=4 / v with d_u=10 (the two compress calls, or their table rows, exchanged)
mutants.expect: mlkem_encaps [encapsulation tcId 26]: c differs at byte 0

mutants.name: wp3-prf-nonce-stuck
mutants.description: K-PKE.KeyGen / Encrypt: the PRF nonce byte N is not incremented between polynomials (s[1] == s[0], e[0] == s[0] ...)
mutants.expect: mlkem_keygen [keyGen tcId 26]: ek differs at byte

mutants.name: wp3-g-missing-k
mutants.description: K-PKE.KeyGen: (rho, sigma) = G(d) instead of G(d || k) - the 33rd byte 0x03 is not absorbed (Kyber-round-3 behaviour)
mutants.expect: mlkem_keygen [keyGen tcId 26]: ek differs at byte

mutants.name: wp3-h-ek-wrong-length
mutants.description: ML-KEM.KeyGen: the H(ek) field of dk is SHA3-256 over 1,152 bytes of ek (t_hat only, rho omitted) instead of all 1,184
mutants.expect: mlkem_keygen [keyGen tcId 26]: dk differs at byte 2336

mutants.name: wp3-ek-check-missing
mutants.description: mlkem_encaps: the per-coefficient < q check on the decoded t_hat is removed (always A=0). Blind to re-encode-and-compare because byte_decode_12 is a raw pass-through - exactly why the check must be an explicit compare
mutants.expect: accepted an ek with a coefficient >= q

mutants.name: wp3-m-not-hashed
mutants.description: mlkem_encaps: (K, r) = G(H(m) || H(ek)) - m is hashed before G, Kyber-round-3 behaviour; FIPS 203 Alg. 17 uses m directly
mutants.expect: mlkem_encaps [encapsulation tcId 26]: c differs at byte
